macro_context.market_sentiment: Strongly bullish with AI tailwinds dominant. S&P 500 hit 7,365.12 (+1.46%) and Nasdaq 25,838.94 (+2.02%) on May 6, both at all-time highs. Semiconductor sector led by AMD (+17.77%) and SMCI (+24.5%) post-earnings beats. May 7 sees mild pullback as oil hovers near $100 and markets await Iran peace deal clarity.
macro_context.fed_outlook: Fed held rates steady at 3.5%-3.75% on April 28-29. Most dissents since October 1992 (4 dissenting votes). Median projection: one rate cut in 2026. Elevated inflation partly driven by Iran war energy prices is complicating the path to cuts.
macro_context.geopolitical: US-Iran conflict is primary risk — oil briefly touched $100/barrel disrupting energy markets and Strait of Hormuz shipping. Peace deal negotiations (nuclear enrichment moratorium) sparked the May 6 market rally. US tariff policy and NATO posture in Greenland are secondary risks. Markets remain resilient, hitting record highs despite the war.
